patch_list: Amazon: Stop feed video autoplay

Stops Amazon's home-feed native video units (live promotional videos, review carousels, sponsored reels) from starting on their own, using the same setPlayWhenReady(true) → false heuristic as the universal 'Disable video autoplay (ExoPlaye…
Dark mode
Force dark mode for Amazon Shopping.
Disable screenshot detection
Prevents the app from detecting screenshots and displaying the share popup on Android 14+.
Disable search suggestions tracking
Prevents search keypress and focus events from being sent with suggestion requests.
Disable video autoplay
Prevents videos from autoplaying in Amazon's in-app WebView pages.
Fix Amazon manifest conflicts
Updates shared Amazon permissions so other Amazon apps can coexist.
Hide Rufus tab
Removes the Rufus AI assistant tab from Amazon's bottom navigation bar.
Open links in browser
Opens non-Amazon URLs in the default browser instead of the in-app WebView.
Price history charts
Injects Keepa and CamelCamelCamel price history charts on Amazon product pages.
Remove ads
Hides sponsored and ad content in Amazon Shopping via CSS injection.
